stdout:
Delete subscriptions. Use this tool to delete subscriptions by IDs.

Usage:
  yutu subscription delete [flags]

Examples:
# Delete a subscription by ID
yutu subscription delete --ids abc123
# Delete multiple subscriptions
yutu subscription delete --ids abc123,def456

Flags:
  -h, --help          help for delete
  -i, --ids strings   IDs of the subscriptions to delete
      --yes           Confirm the operation
